entities.summary: Piergiorgio Colautti is an Italian modern painter and sculptor. He is known for his own distinctive style, sometimes labelled "Hyperfuturism", in which figurative elements are enmeshed and submerged by symbols reflecting a cold and modern technological world. He lives and works in Rome.
